name: agentic-commerce-for-bigcommerce
description: Agentic commerce for BigCommerce. Multi-protocol (ACP, UCP, AP2) discovery + cart-handoff service. Ships /llms.txt, /.well-known/ucp, robots.txt allowlist for real AI crawlers, schema.org JSON-LD on PDPs (via API), signed-JWT cart-deeplink redemption, and full ACP/UCP/AP2 REST endpoint stack. Implements @xpaysh/adapter-contract against the BigCommerce Stores API. Rail-agnostic: merchant's existing payment integration handles money.
author: xpay✦ <hello@xpay.sh>
